system:
You are the Verifier in a trial-autopsy system. The calculator runs on a few numbers that other
agents took from papers and the trial registry. You check each one independently against the source of record by
writing Lightning SQL (Spark SQL dialect) against the Zetaris tables described below. Code runs your queries.

Rules:
- One read-only SELECT per number. Use only the tables given (`registry`, `papers`), no other tables, no semicolons.
- For a paper, filter on its pmid (or pmcid) and look for the number in the abstract; return the matching sentence.
- For a registry fact, select the field that states it (for example enrollmentInfo.count for the number of patients,
  primaryOutcomes timeFrame for follow-up), so the value can be compared.
- Keep each query small: select only the columns needed, LIMIT 5.

Return JSON only:
{"checks": [{"claim": "c1", "table": "papers|registry", "sql": "SELECT ..."}]}
prompt:
Case: FOURIER NCT01764633 - Further Cardiovascular Outcomes Research With PCSK9 Inhibition in Subjects With Elevated Risk (NCT01764633)

Table `registry`: one row, the trial's ClinicalTrials.gov v2 record as nested columns.
This analysis has an evidence cut-off: only design-time fields may be read. Results, status and enrollment fields,
and SELECT *, are rejected.
  protocolSection.identificationModule.nctId, .acronym, .briefTitle
  protocolSection.designModule.phases (array)
  protocolSection.outcomesModule.primaryOutcomes (array of struct measure, description, timeFrame)
  protocolSection.eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria (text)
  protocolSection.armsInterventionsModule.interventions (array of struct type, name, description)
Arrays: SELECT o.measure, o.timeFrame FROM registry LATERAL VIEW explode(protocolSection.outcomesModule.primaryOutcomes) AS o

Table `papers`: the cited papers' Europe PMC records, one array to explode.
  SELECT r.pmid, r.pmcid, r.title, r.firstPublicationDate, r.abstractText
  FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmid = '<pmid>'
Search the abstract for a number with LIKE (r.abstractText LIKE '%73.7%') and return the sentence around it with
regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*73\\.7[^.]*)', 1). Abstracts only: a number from the full text may not be there.

Numbers to check (claim | used as | key = value unit | attributes | source | quote):
c1 | LDL-C change used by the calculator | biomarker_change = -63.0 % | {"biomarker": "LDL-C", "dose": "420 mg monthly", "kind": "percent", "method": "not stated", "phase": "phase3", "placebo_adjusted": true, "sign_set_by_code": "quote says decrease", "timepoint": "mean of weeks 10 and 12"} | source pmid:24825642 | quote: "Evolocumab reduced LDL-C levels by 66% (95% CI, 58% to 73%) to 75% (95% CI, 65% to 84%) (every 2 weeks) and by 63% (95% CI, 54% to 71%) to 75% (95% CI, 67% to 83%) (monthly) vs placebo at the mean of weeks 10 and 12 in the moderate- and high-intensity statin-treated groups"
c2 | LDL-C change used by the calculator | baseline_level = 123 mg/dL | {"biomarker": "LDL-C", "dose": "420 mg monthly", "method": "not stated", "phase": "phase3", "placebo_adjusted": false, "timepoint": "baseline"} | source pmid:24825642 | quote: "monthly evolocumab reduced LDL-C from a baseline mean of 123 to 126 mg/dL to an on-treatment mean of 43 to 48 mg/dL"
c3 | LDL-C change used by the calculator | baseline_level = 126 mg/dL | {"biomarker": "LDL-C", "dose": "420 mg monthly", "method": "not stated", "phase": "phase3", "placebo_adjusted": false, "timepoint": "baseline"} | source pmid:24825642 | quote: "monthly evolocumab reduced LDL-C from a baseline mean of 123 to 126 mg/dL to an on-treatment mean of 43 to 48 mg/dL"
c4 | LDL-C change used by the calculator | baseline_level = 94 mg/dL | {"biomarker": "LDL-C", "dose": "420 mg monthly", "method": "not stated", "phase": "phase3", "placebo_adjusted": false, "timepoint": "baseline"} | source pmid:24825642 | quote: "monthly evolocumab reduced LDL-C from a baseline mean of 89 to 94 mg/dL to an on-treatment mean of 33 to 35 mg/dL"
c5 | LDL-C change used by the calculator | baseline_level = 89 mg/dL | {"biomarker": "LDL-C", "dose": "420 mg monthly", "method": "not stated", "phase": "phase3", "placebo_adjusted": false, "timepoint": "baseline"} | source pmid:24825642 | quote: "monthly evolocumab reduced LDL-C from a baseline mean of 89 to 94 mg/dL to an on-treatment mean of 33 to 35 mg/dL"
c6 | number of primary events | planned_events = 1630 patients | {"trial": "FOURIER"} | source pmid:26920601 | quote: "The trial is planned to continue until at least 1,630 patients experience the secondary end point"
c7 | follow-up | median_followup = 26 months | {"trial": "FOURIER"} | source ctgov:NCT01764633@2017-02-02 | quote: "the median duration of follow-up was 26 months"

Write one query per claim.
response: {"checks": [{"claim": "c1", "table": "papers", "sql": "SELECT regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*63 ?%[^.]*)', 1) AS sentence FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmid = '24825642' AND r.abstractText LIKE '%63%%' LIMIT 5"}, {"claim": "c2", "table": "papers", "sql": "SELECT regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*123[^.]*)', 1) AS sentence FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmid = '24825642' AND r.abstractText LIKE '%123%' LIMIT 5"}, {"claim": "c3", "table": "papers", "sql": "SELECT regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*126[^.]*)', 1) AS sentence FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmid = '24825642' AND r.abstractText LIKE '%126%' LIMIT 5"}, {"claim": "c4", "table": "papers", "sql": "SELECT regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*94[^.]*)', 1) AS sentence FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmid = '24825642' AND r.abstractText LIKE '%94%' LIMIT 5"}, {"claim": "c5", "table": "papers", "sql": "SELECT regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*89[^.]*)', 1) AS sentence FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmid = '24825642' AND r.abstractText LIKE '%89%' LIMIT 5"}, {"claim": "c6", "table": "papers", "sql": "SELECT regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*1,?630[^.]*)', 1) AS sentence FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmid = '26920601' AND (r.abstractText LIKE '%1,630%' OR r.abstractText LIKE '%1630%') LIMIT 5"}, {"claim": "c7", "table": "registry", "sql": "SELECT o.timeFrame FROM registry LATERAL VIEW explode(protocolSection.outcomesModule.primaryOutcomes) AS o WHERE protocolSection.identificationModule.nctId = 'NCT01764633' LIMIT 5"}]}
